proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _
  refine ⟨?_, fun H => inferInstance, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := G)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp (hg a)
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp (hg b)
    exact zpow_mul_comm g m n
  · intro N _
    exact isCyclic_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N)
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [IsCyclic G], (∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a) ∧ (∀ H : Subgroup G, IsCyclic H) ∧ (∀ (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal], IsCyclic (G ⧸ N))
